ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base comprising approximately 85-90% of the surface area, contrasted with high-intensity (white) linear and focal markings occupying the remaining 10-15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white linear striations traversing both lobes; high-contrast white focal patches concentrated at the distal tips; primary dark pigment is continuous across the central and lower fluke regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing boundary; distinct macro-notches located mid-way between the central notch and distal tips on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the tips; the leading edge exhibits a broad convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular white pixel aggregates at the distal tips of both lobes, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly visible sets of parallel white linear marks (rake marks) distributed across both the left and right lobes, primarily in diagonal and horizontal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across both lobes; significant irregularity and chipping along the trailing edge margin suggestive of previous mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Water droplets and splash patterns occlude the lower central portion of the fluke and the insertion point at the peduncle.
